## Notes

Frontier Developments; backer alpha December 2013; full release 2014-12-16 (Windows); Xbox One 2015, PS4 2017; VR support; Stellar Forge 1:1 Milky Way of ~400 billion systems; Background Simulation of factions and economies; Powerplay (2015); Solo, Private Group, Open modes; Odyssey 2021.
